summary: The selected-result closure stands. All 41 source files matched their recorded hashes and sizes, and I reproduced all seven computed claims. Avp and Oxt agree in direction with the registered analysis. Across all 13 paired heatmap markers, seven directions agree and six differ. The corrected proposal clarifies the inferred sham identities, conflicting expression-unit labels, and ambiguous P-value rule. It passed the ledger validator. [Published Figure 2](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41398-024-02930-y/figures/2)
openIssues: The plotted controls match deposited SHAM-2 and SHAM-3. The authors’ fitted DESeq2 sample manifest and animal-to-library assignments remain unknown.
The full author DESeq2 results and exact discovery rule remain unavailable. Genome-wide concordance and discovery overlap remain unassessed.
